title: Dialpad Pricing in 2026: Connect, Sell, Support and Alternatives
summary: Dialpad lists Connect from $15, Sell from $39 and Support from $89 per user a month billed annually, or $27, $49 and $109 billed monthly. See what adds cost.
body_markdown:
Dialpad publishes its prices. Billed annually, Dialpad Connect, the business phone plan, is $15 or $25 per user per month. Dialpad Sell, the sales plan, is $39, $59 or $79. Dialpad Support, the contact center plan, is $89, $119 or $149. Billed monthly, the same plans run from $27 to $179. Connect Enterprise and the Resolve AI agents are quoted. There is a 14-day free trial. Read on November 17, 2026.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a competing dialer. Every Dialpad detail below comes from Dialpad's own pricing page, rates page, terms and help center, opened on November 17, 2026. No price here comes from a review site, and no Dialpad account was used or tested. Prices are Dialpad's US list prices in US dollars. For a feature-by-feature view, see[Trellus vs. Dialpad](https://www.trellus.ai/compare/trellus-vs-dialpad) .


## Dialpad pricing at a glance


Dialpad's[pricing page](https://www.dialpad.com/pricing/) has four tabs: Resolve, Support, Sell and Connect. Each priced plan has an annual and a monthly figure behind a toggle.


Dialpad plans per user per month in US dollars, from Dialpad's own pricing page, read on November 17, 2026. The page states no seat minimum. Plan Billed annually Billed monthly Seat minimum Free trial What is included for calling


Connect Standard $15 $27 None stated 14 days A direct line per user, unlimited US and Canada calling except toll-free, SMS and MMS, AI transcripts and call summaries


Connect Pro $25 $35 None stated 14 days Standard plus CRM integrations such as Salesforce and HubSpot, 24/7 support and automatic recording on shared lines


Connect Enterprise Not published Not published None stated Talk to sales Pro plus single sign-on and unlimited office locations


Sell Essentials $39 $49 None stated Try free button Unlimited US and Canada minutes, AI transcripts and recaps, Coaching Teams, CRM integrations, one year of recordings


Sell Advanced $59 $70 None stated Talk to sales Essentials plus Reach Booster (local presence dialing and voicemail drop) and Live Coach


Sell Premium $79 $95 None stated Talk to sales Advanced plus Quality Management: AI CSAT, Scorecards and Playbooks


Support Essentials $89 $109 None stated Try free button Voice and digital routing, Power Dialer, analytics, screen recording, Reach Booster. Direct lines and unlimited calling are optional add-ons


Support Advanced $119 $145 None stated Talk to sales Essentials plus Live Coach and Quality Management


Support Premium $149 $179 None stated Talk to sales Advanced plus Workforce Management


Resolve Custom Custom None stated Talk to sales Voice and digital AI agents, billed per conversation from a pool of AI Agent Credits


The page says the price a buyer sees can differ by region and currency. Dialpad's[sign-up guide](https://help.dialpad.com/hc/en-us/articles/54825670402587-Sign-Up-for-Dialpad) says the trial lasts 14 days, that a payment method is entered at sign-up, and that extra numbers cannot be added during the trial.


## What changes the real cost of Dialpad


The seat price is public. The bill also depends on the term, calling usage, the dialer, numbers and add-ons.


### Annual or monthly billing


Monthly billing costs more on every plan. Connect Standard is $27 against $15, and Sell Advanced is $70 against $59. Ten Sell Advanced users come to $590 a month on annual billing, or $700 billed monthly.


The pricing page's own FAQ says Advanced accounts can be month to month or annual, while Premium accounts are annual only. The monthly toggle still shows a price for Premium, so ask which terms apply to the plan you want.


### Calling minutes and texts


Connect includes unlimited calling within the US and Canada. Sell and Support are less clear. The pricing page lists unlimited US and Canada minutes on Sell. Dialpad's[rates page](https://www.dialpad.com/rates/) says Sell and Support seats are charged $0.01 a minute for inbound calls, $0.02 a minute for outbound calls and $0.008 a message for texts within the US and Canada. The[call rate FAQ](https://help.dialpad.com/hc/en-us/articles/54845120013979-Call-Rate-FAQs) also says Sell and Support licenses are charged per-minute rates.


On Support, the plan table marks unlimited calling as an optional add-on. The[Unlimited Domestic Calling Add-on](https://help.dialpad.com/hc/en-us/articles/54929786118171-Unlimited-Domestic-Calling-Add-on) is a flat monthly fee for contact center users, with a fair-use limit of 3,000 minutes per license a month. Its price is not published.


Connect and Sell include 250 outbound texts a month, pooled across the account. The rates page lists $0.008 for each extra US text on Connect. Inbound calls to toll-free numbers are billed by the minute on every plan. International calls use prepaid credits at the rates Dialpad lists by country.


### The dialer


Dialpad's sources differ on which plan includes its dialer. The pricing page lists a Power Dialer on every Support plan and marks it not applicable on Sell. The[Dialer article](https://help.dialpad.com/hc/en-us/articles/54603604644891-Dialpad-Dialer) , updated on November 13, 2026, says the Dialpad Dialer needs Sell Premium, or Support with the Dialer Add-on. The[setup guide](https://help.dialpad.com/hc/en-us/articles/54604216863259-Setup-Dialpad-Dialer-for-Offices-and-Contact-Centers) lists a Contact Center, Sell Premium licenses and outbound calling credits. Prices for the Dialer Add-on and the credits are not published.


### Numbers, local presence and add-ons


Connect and Sell give each user a direct line. Extra local and toll-free numbers are add-ons on every plan, and Dialpad's[numbers guide](https://help.dialpad.com/hc/en-us/articles/55081748118683-Add-Local-or-Toll-Free-Numbers) says they carry fees without naming the amount. Local presence dialing needs a local number package that is sold separately. That price is not published either.


The plan tables mark Live Coach, Quality Management, Workforce Management and Business Intelligence as optional add-ons on lower tiers. None has a price on the pricing page.


### Contract, renewal and refunds


Dialpad's[terms of service](https://www.dialpad.com/legal/) say a term renews for the same length unless the customer gives notice at least 30 days before it ends. A customer who leaves an annual term early still owes the rest of it. The[refund FAQ](https://help.dialpad.com/hc/en-us/articles/54926238981403-Dialpad-Cancellation-and-Refund-FAQs) allows a refund only within three days of a card payment, and none for unused licenses or credits.


The[cancellation guide](https://help.dialpad.com/hc/en-us/articles/54920599156251-Cancel-Your-Dialpad-Account) says month-to-month accounts with 25 or fewer licenses can cancel in their settings. Annual plans and larger accounts go through Dialpad's team. The[billing FAQ](https://help.dialpad.com/hc/en-us/articles/54925748191259-Dialpad-Billing-FAQs) says invoiced contracts have a minimum user requirement, without giving the number.


### What to confirm in writing


Dialpad's[facts page](https://www.dialpad.com/llm-info/) lists different amounts for Sell and Support than the pricing page does, and points readers to the pricing page for current prices. Ask for the seat price on the term you want, the per-minute rates for your plan, and the price of each add-on, number and the dialer.


## Who Dialpad fits and who it does not


Dialpad's pricing page presents one AI platform with products for business calling, sales teams, contact centers and AI agents. That fits a team that wants one vendor for business phone numbers, texting, video meetings and inbound routing. Connect fits an office that mostly needs a phone system with unlimited domestic calling.


Sell fits a sales team that wants call transcripts, recaps and coaching at a published price. Support fits a contact center that needs voice and digital routing, and its higher tiers bundle quality management and workforce management.


Dialpad is a weaker fit for a team whose main need is high-volume outbound dialing from lists in its CRM. Its help center describes a progressive dialer that runs campaigns through a Contact Center and needs Sell Premium or a Support add-on, plus calling credits. It is also a weaker fit for a buyer who needs one all-in price, because usage, numbers and add-ons can sit outside the seat price.


## Dialpad alternatives with published per-seat prices


These vendors print a seat price on their own pricing pages. Calling usage, numbers and taxes can be extra.

**Trellus** is a Chrome extension that adds power and parallel dialing inside the CRM, sales engagement platform or spreadsheet a team already uses. It works with 31 platforms. The[Trellus power dialer](https://www.trellus.ai/power-dialer) plan, Power, is $99.99 per seat per month. The[Trellus parallel dialer](https://www.trellus.ai/parallel-dialer) plan, Power + Parallel, is $149.99 and calls up to five numbers at once. Both are bought online with no seat minimum. There is no free plan or free trial, and the Business plan is custom. The plan details are on[Trellus pricing](https://www.trellus.ai/pricing) .


Texting is not listed in Trellus plans. A team that keeps Dialpad can add Trellus coaching, part of the Business plan, to supported calls in the[Dialpad web app](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations/dialpad) .


For contact center software, see[Five9 pricing](https://www.trellus.ai/post/five9-pricing) . For dialers, see[Kixie pricing](https://www.trellus.ai/post/kixie-pricing) and[PhoneBurner pricing](https://www.trellus.ai/post/phoneburner-pricing) . See also the guide to[Dialpad alternatives](https://www.trellus.ai/post/best-dialpad-alternative) .


## Frequently asked questions


### How much does Dialpad cost per user?


On annual billing, Dialpad lists Connect at $15 or $25, Sell at $39, $59 or $79, and Support at $89, $119 or $149 per user a month. Billed monthly, Connect is $27 or $35, Sell is $49, $70 or $95, and Support is $109, $145 or $179. Connect Enterprise and Resolve are quoted.


### Does Dialpad have a free trial?


Yes. Dialpad offers a 14-day free trial. Its pricing page shows a Try free button on Connect Standard, Connect Pro, Sell Essentials and Support Essentials. The other plans start with a sales call. A payment method is entered at sign-up.


### Are calls unlimited on Dialpad?


On Connect, yes, for calls within the US and Canada, excluding toll-free. For Sell and Support, Dialpad's rates page lists $0.01 a minute inbound and $0.02 a minute outbound, while the pricing page lists unlimited US and Canada minutes on Sell. Confirm the terms for your plan before you buy.


### Which Dialpad plan includes the power dialer?


Dialpad's sources differ. The pricing page lists a Power Dialer on all three Support plans. The help center says the Dialpad Dialer needs Sell Premium, or Support with the Dialer Add-on, plus a Contact Center and outbound calling credits. The add-on and credit prices are not published.
